*

* Michael Hoang 02-03-94 2.0 DM changes

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
--This trigger needs to be updated when Master codes is updated with
--the codes for Inventory class. Select ... into ...
--listval for this field should also be updated
--crl_blk_1.inventory_class.
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select substr(code,1,2), code_desc
 into :ctrl_blk_1.inventory_class, :ctrl_blk_1.s_class_desc
 from vserv_inventory_class
 where :ctrl_blk_1.inventory_class = substr(code,1,2)
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('5307');
 :ctrl_blk_1.inventory_class := '';
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-TEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :g_standard := 'STANDARD';
 :g_inven_type := 'MI';
 :g_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :s_dummy_custmr := :ctrl_blk_1.g_standard;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :ctrl_blk_1.product_type is null
 then
 :s_dummy_product := '%';
 else
 begin
 select product_type, product_type_desc
 into :ctrl_blk_1.product_type, :s_type_desc
 from vserv_product_types v
 where product_type = :ctrl_blk_1.product_type
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 :s_dummy_product := :ctrl_blk_1.product_type;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 -- Invalid product type
 show_error_dist('0322');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_abo VARCHAR2(4);
 temp_desc VARCHAR2(20);
begin
 if :ctrl_blk_1.blood_type_desc is null
 then
 :s_dummy_abo := '%';
 else
 temp_desc := :ctrl_blk_1.blood_type_desc;
 parse_abo('M', temp_abo, temp_desc);
 if temp_abo is null
 then
 -- Invalid Blood Type
 show_error_dist('0300');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :ctrl_blk_1.blood_type_desc := temp_desc;
 :ctrl_blk_1.blood_type := temp_abo;
 :s_dummy_abo := :ctrl_blk_1.blood_type;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :ctrl_blk_1.attrib_group is not null
 then
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from vserv_attributes
 where attrib_group = :ctrl_blk_1.attrib_group
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 -- Invalid Attribute Group
 show_error_dist('0301');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :ctrl_blk_1.attrib_code is not null
 then
 begin
 if :ctrl_blk_1.attrib_group is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.attrib_group');
 -- Field Must Be Entered
 show_error_dist('0204');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 begin
 select attrib_desc into :attrib_desc
 from vserv_attributes
 where attrib_code = :ctrl_blk_1.attrib_code
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)
 and attrib_group = :ctrl_blk_1.attrib_group
 and rownum < 2;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 -- Invalid Attribute Code
 show_error_dist('0305');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 end;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 go_block('inven_levels');
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if :inven_levels.s_cust_alpha is null
 then
 -- No products Found
 show_error_dist('5007');
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.attrib_code');
 end if;
end;

Block.Name: INVEN_LEVELS
Block.WhereClause: where ((:ctrl_blk_1.attrib_group is null and customer_id like :s_dummy_custmr and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id and inventory_type = :g_inven_type and inventory_class = :ctrl_blk_1.inventory_class and product_type like :s_dummy_product and attrib_group is null and attrib_code is null and blood_type like :s_dummy_abo) or (:ctrl_blk_1.attrib_group is not null and customer_id like :s_dummy_custmr and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id and inventory_type = :g_inven_type and inventory_class = :ctrl_blk_1.inventory_class and product_type like :s_dummy_product and blood_type like :s_dummy_abo and attrib_group = :ctrl_blk_1.attrib_group and attrib_code like nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.attrib_code,'%')))

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 begin
 select alpha_key into :s_cust_alpha
 from customers
 where customer_id like :inven_levels.customer_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 -- Invalid Customer Id
 show_error_dist('0302');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select product_type_desc into :s_prod_desc
 from vserv_product_types
 where product_type = :inven_levels.product_type
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*)
 into :inven_levels.actual
 from active_products ap
 where inventory_class = :inven_levels.inventory_class
 and product_type = :inven_levels.product_type
 and blood_type = nvl(:inven_levels.blood_type, blood_type)
 and stock_state='AV'
 and exp_date > sysdate
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and ( :ctrl_blk_1.attrib_group is null
 or (:ctrl_blk_1.attrib_group is not null
 and exists( select 'X'
 from unit_attributes ua
 where ua.unit_id = ap.unit_id
 and ua.coll_date = ap.coll_date
 and ua.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and ua.attrib_code = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.attrib_code, attrib_code)
 and ua.attrib_group = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.attrib_group, attrib_group)
 union
 select 'X'
 from component_attributes ca
 where ca.unit_id = ap.unit_id
 and ca.coll_date = ap.coll_date
 and ca.product_code = ap.product_code
 and ca.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and ca.attrib_code = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.attrib_code, attrib_code)
 and ca.attrib_group = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.attrib_group, attrib_group))))
 and not exists (select 'x' from component_interdictions 
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = ap.unit_id 
 and coll_date = ap.coll_date
 and product_code = ap.product_code) 
 and not exists (select 'x' 
 from unit_interdictions ui, valid_interdictions_lab vi
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = ap.unit_id
 and coll_date = ap.coll_date
 and ui.inter_code = vi.inter_code 
 and vi.inter_type != 'I'
 and sysdate between eff_date 
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate));
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :inven_levels.actual := 0;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select qty
 into :inven_levels.optimal
 from set_inventory_levels
 where (( :ctrl_blk_1.attrib_group is null
 and inventory_class = :inven_levels.inventory_class
 and customer_id = :inven_levels.customer_id
 and product_type = :inven_levels.product_type
 and blood_type = :inven_levels.blood_type
 and attrib_group is null
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and inventory_type = 'OP')
 or
 (:ctrl_blk_1.attrib_group is not null
 and inventory_class = :inven_levels.inventory_class
 and customer_id = :inven_levels.customer_id
 and product_type = :inven_levels.product_type
 and blood_type = :inven_levels.blood_type
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and attrib_group = :ctrl_blk_1.attrib_group
 and attrib_code = :ctrl_blk_1.attrib_code
 and inventory_type = 'OP'));
 Exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :inven_levels.optimal := 0;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select abo_desc into :inven_levels.s_blood_type
 from vserv_abo
 where substr(abo_code,1,2) = :inven_levels.blood_type
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)
 and rownum < 2 ;
 Exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_BLOOD_TYPE__LOV2
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select v.abo_desc from vserv_abo v where exists (select 'x' from set_inventory_levels where blood_type = substr(v.abo_code,1,2) and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id and inventory_type = :g_inven_type and exists (select 'x' from vserv_product_types p where p.product_type like :s_dummy_product) ) order by abo_code

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_PRODUCT_TYP_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select product_type, product_type_desc from vserv_product_types v where sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) and exists (select 'x' from set_inventory_levels i where i.product_type = v.product_type and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id and inventory_type = :g_inven_type and customer_id like :s_dummy_custmr) order by product_type

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_INVENTORY_C_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select substr(code,1,2), code_desc from vserv_inventory_class order by code
